fields.label: Location
fields.note: Location text from the listing card's ul.list-inline; the board has no location control.

fields.label: Employment type
fields.note: From the job page JSON-LD employmentType; no native facet.

notes: The ledger URL https://www.flexcar.com/careers returns 404; the homepage publishes https://careers.flexcar.com/ (JazzHR/Resumator skin, canonical /apply). The board is a single server-rendered <ul class="list-group"> under "Current Openings" with one anchor per posting and no search box, facet bar, load-more or pagination. Each /apply/<10-char-code>/<slug> page is both the job page and the apply page. Only local filtering is possible.
